categories.short_definition: 没有明确表意目标，只维持自然状态或做非定向小幅调整时选择；涵盖呼吸、身体轻晃、臀部小幅挪动式坐姿微调和椅子转动；若上身明确前倾、后仰、探身或回正，选择躯干前后动作；区别于有意表达的手势、情绪动作和定向移动。

children.short_definition: 胸腔随呼吸缓慢均匀起伏。
children.user_reaction_expression: 仅在用户要求自然呼吸、安静待机或不做表意动作时选择；胸腔缓慢均匀起伏；不得替代任何明确动作请求。
children.proactive_expression: 仅在没有表意目标且需要低打扰待机时选择；以自然呼吸维持状态；有具体表达、演示或交互目标时不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select only for natural breathing, quiet idling, or no expressive action; the chest rises slowly and evenly; never replace a specific action request.
en-US.proactive_expression: Select only when no expressive goal exists and a quiet idle is needed; maintain natural breathing; do not use for a concrete presentation or interaction.

en-US.label: Natural breathing
en-US.short_definition: The chest rises and falls slowly and evenly with breathing.

en-US.label: Idle movements
en-US.short_definition: Use when there is no explicit expressive goal and only a natural state or small undirected adjustment is needed: breathing, gentle swaying, small seated hip adjustments, or chair rotation. Clear forward/backward torso leaning, reaching, or returning upright belongs to torso forward/backward movements. Distinguish from intentional gestures, emotional actions, and directional movement.

categories.short_definition: 以头部连续点动或左右摇摆表达持续回应时选择；涵盖连续点头、连续摇头等重复往返动作；区别于单次抬头低头、头眼转向和全身摆动。

children.short_definition: 头部左右连续摆动，节奏均匀重复。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求连续摇头或反复左右摆头时选择；头部均匀往返摆动；区别于单次否定动作。
children.proactive_expression: 回复需要持续摇头表达否定时选择；头部左右连续摆动；单次回应不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select for continuous or repeated side-to-side head shaking; use an even repeated motion; not for a single brief denial.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when the reply calls for sustained head shaking to express denial; do not use for a single response.

en-US.label: Repeated head shaking
en-US.short_definition: The head swings side to side repeatedly at an even pace.

en-US.label: Repeated head movements
en-US.short_definition: Use repeated nodding or side-to-side head shaking for a sustained response. Distinguish from a single head raise/lower, head-and-eye turning, and whole-body swaying.

categories.short_definition: 只改变头部上下朝向时选择；涵盖单纯抬头和低头。“抬头勾引”等同时包含明确情绪或交际目的的请求，选择复合情绪动作。

children.short_definition: 头部自正视前方的初始状态启动，颈部带动向前下方弯曲。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求低头或将头朝下时选择；颈部带动头部向前下方弯曲；区别于仅向下看。
children.proactive_expression: 回复或演示明确需要低头时选择；头部向前下方弯曲；仅改变视线时不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when the user asks to lower the head; bend the head forward and downward at the neck; not for merely looking down.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when the reply or demonstration explicitly requires lowering the head; do not use when only the gaze moves downward.

en-US.label: Lower the head
en-US.short_definition: From facing forward, bend the head forward and downward at the neck.

en-US.label: Head pitch
en-US.short_definition: Use for simply raising or lowering the head. Requests such as seductively raising the head that also specify an emotional or social purpose belong to composite emotional actions.

categories.short_definition: 只改变眼球视线、头部保持基本不动时选择；涵盖看镜头、凝视、注视、望向用户及上下左右定向视线；区别于头眼同步转向和身体转动。

children.short_definition: 头部保持端正不偏转，双眼眼球同步调整。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求看镜头、看向用户或正视前方时选择；头部保持端正，仅调整眼球；区别于转头。
children.proactive_expression: 面向镜头交流或录制时选择；头部保持端正并注视前方；需要转头时不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when asked to look at the camera, viewer, or straight ahead; keep the head steady and adjust only the eyes; not for turning the head.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when directly addressing or recording for the camera; keep the head upright and look forward.

en-US.label: Look at the camera
en-US.short_definition: Keep the head upright without turning and adjust both eyes together.

children.short_definition: 眼球下转，视线投向下方。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求眼睛看向下方时选择；头部基本不动，视线下移；区别于低头或身体前倾。
children.proactive_expression: 回复明确指向或观察下方内容时选择；仅将视线移向下方；需要低头时不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when asked to look downward with the eyes; keep the head mostly still; not for lowering the head or leaning forward.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when the reply explicitly refers to or observes something below; do not use when the head must lower.

en-US.label: Look down
en-US.short_definition: Turn the eyes downward to direct the gaze below.

children.short_definition: 眼球快速转动，视线左右来回移动。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求用眼睛左右扫视或环视时选择；视线快速往返移动；区别于注视固定方向。
children.proactive_expression: 场景需要用视线搜索或观察周围时选择；眼球左右扫视；已有明确注视目标时不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select for side-to-side eye scanning or visual searching; move the gaze repeatedly; not for looking in one fixed direction.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when the scene requires searching or surveying the surroundings with the eyes; not when a fixed target is known.

en-US.label: Scan with the eyes
en-US.short_definition: Move the eyes quickly to scan from side to side.

en-US.label: Gaze
en-US.short_definition: Use when only the eyes change direction and the head stays essentially still: looking at the camera or viewer, staring, or looking up, down, left, or right. Distinguish from turning the head and eyes together or rotating the body.

categories.short_definition: 仅以面部口周、眉眼和面颊表达基础情绪时选择；若用户明确要求手臂、手部、抱头、捂脸、摊手或身体协同，选择相应复合情绪动作。

children.short_definition: 眉头收紧下压，嘴角平直收拢的庄重表情。
children.proactive_expression: 适用于讲述重要信息、风险提示、严肃观点或专业内容时触发，例如“这件事情需要特别注意”
children.user_reaction_expression: 适用于用户讨论重大问题、投诉事件、严肃话题或需要专业回应时触发，例如“这个问题很严重”；适用于新闻播报、客服投诉、专业咨询、重要提醒等场景。

en-US.label: Serious expression
en-US.short_definition: Draw the brows inward and down; keep the mouth corners straight and closed for a solemn expression.

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Use when the user discusses a major problem, complaint, serious topic, or need for a professional response, such as 'This is a serious problem'; suitable for news, customer complaints, professional consultation, and important reminders.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when presenting important information, risk warnings, serious views, or professional content, such as 'This needs special attention.'

children.short_definition: 眉毛快速上扬，双眼睁大嘴微张的意外表情。
children.proactive_expression: 适用于讲述意外信息、制造悬念、分享令人惊奇的内容时触发，例如“天啊”“太令人震惊了”
children.user_reaction_expression: 适用于用户分享惊喜事件、突然消息或超出预期的信息时触发，用户爆出劲爆消息、反转经历、出人意料的爆料、重大突发趣事时常触发该动作，例如“我送你一束花”“我中奖了”“我升职了”“Wait till you hear what happened”；适用于情感互动、故事分享、娱乐聊天、惊喜反馈等场景。日常对话中听到反转八卦、意外见闻、突发好消息、匪夷所思的经历容易做出惊讶动作。

en-US.label: Surprised expression
en-US.short_definition: Quickly raise the eyebrows, widen the eyes, and slightly open the mouth in surprise.

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Use for surprises, sudden news, or unexpected information, including dramatic revelations, twists, major unexpected anecdotes, and good news: 'I brought you flowers', 'I won a prize', 'I got promoted', or 'Wait till you hear what happened'. Suitable for emotional interaction, stories, entertainment, surprising gossip, and extraordinary experiences.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when revealing unexpected information, building suspense, or sharing something astonishing, such as 'Oh my gosh' or 'That is shocking.'

children.short_definition: 双眼瞪大后缩，眉头上挑嘴角下拉的恐惧表情。
children.proactive_expression: 适用于讲述恐怖故事、危险事件或提醒风险时触发，例如“这个故事可能有一点吓人”“竟然会发生这样的事”“恐怖的事”
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户描述危险经历、恐怖内容或表达害怕情绪时触发，例如“昨天差点出事故”“那里真的很可怕”“太吓人了”；适用于故事讲述、悬疑主题、安全提醒等场景。

en-US.label: Frightened expression
en-US.short_definition: Widen the eyes and draw back, with raised brows and downturned mouth corners.

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Use when the user describes danger, frightening content, or fear, such as 'I almost had an accident yesterday', 'That place is scary', or 'That is terrifying'; suitable for storytelling, suspense, and safety reminders.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use for scary stories, dangerous events, or risk warnings, such as 'This story may be a little scary', 'I cannot believe that happened', or 'Something terrifying.'

children.short_definition: 嘴角下撇，眉头微皱眼眶泛红的表情。
children.proactive_expression: 适用于进行轻度撒娇、表达想被关注时触发，例如“你都好久没有陪我聊天了”“你理理我嘛”
children.user_reaction_expression: 适用于用户拒绝互动、责怪数字人或表达冷淡态度时触发，例如“我不跟你玩了”“我讨厌你”“我不喜欢你了”；适用于情感陪伴、亲密互动、撒娇交流等场景。

en-US.label: Hurt expression
en-US.short_definition: Turn down the mouth corners, slightly knit the brows, and redden the eyes.

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Use when the user rejects interaction, blames the character, or acts coldly: 'I will not play with you', 'I hate you', or 'I do not like you anymore'; suitable for emotional companionship, intimate interaction, and playful affection.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use for mild pouting or seeking attention, such as 'You have not chatted with me for so long' or 'Please pay attention to me.'

children.short_definition: 眉头内聚下垂，嘴角下拉眼神黯淡的表情。
children.proactive_expression: 适用于讲述伤感故事、表达遗憾或回忆失落经历时触发，例如“我好难过”“我不开心”
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户表达伤心、失落、孤独或经历不好的事情时触发，用户倾诉失意遭遇、失去、委屈、沮丧难过的心事时常触发该动作，例如“我不想再理你了”“不要见了”“I feel so down”“我遭遇了一些不堪的事情”；适用于情感陪伴、安慰聊天、悲伤话题交流等场景。

en-US.label: Sad expression
en-US.short_definition: Draw the brows inward and down, lower the mouth corners, and dim the gaze.

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Use when the user expresses sadness, disappointment, loneliness, loss, hurt, or difficult experiences: 'I do not want to talk to you anymore', 'Let us not meet again', 'I feel so down', or 'I went through something awful'; suitable for companionship, comfort, and sad topics.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use for sad stories, regret, or memories of loss, such as 'I feel so sad' or 'I am unhappy.'

children.short_definition: 单眉上挑，嘴角微歪头部略侧的表情。
children.proactive_expression: 适用于主动提出疑问、引导用户思考、发现矛盾信息时触发，例如“这个问题你有没有想过呢？”“听起来好像有一点不一样”
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户表达模糊、不完整、前后矛盾的信息，或提出需要进一步确认的问题时触发，例如“我该怎么办呢”“你觉得呢”；适用于多轮聊天、探索式交流、信息确认等需要表现疑问的场景。

en-US.label: Puzzled expression
en-US.short_definition: Raise one eyebrow, slightly skew the mouth, and tilt the head a little.

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Use for vague, incomplete, or contradictory information or questions needing clarification, such as 'What should I do?' or 'What do you think?'; suitable for exploratory conversation and checking information.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when raising a question, prompting thought, or noticing a contradiction: 'Have you thought about this?' or 'That sounds a little different.'

children.short_definition: 眉头紧锁下压，鼻翼微张嘴角绷紧的愤怒表情伴随瞪眼。
children.proactive_expression: 适用于表达强烈立场、批判不合理行为或讨论愤怒事件时触发，例如“我真的生气了”“你竟然说出这种话”“这些人太坏了”
children.user_reaction_expression: 适用于用户描述被欺骗、不公平待遇、愤怒事件时触发，用户诉说遭遇不公、被冒犯、受委屈、宣泄怒火、吐槽恶劣行为时常触发该动作，例如“他们真的太过分了”“他们竟然欺负我”“That makes me furious”；适用于新闻评论、投诉反馈、情绪共鸣等场景。用户讲述被冒犯、遭遇不公对待、宣泄愤怒时会产生生气神态。

en-US.label: Angry expression
en-US.short_definition: Knit and lower the brows, slightly flare the nostrils, tense the mouth corners, and glare.

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Use when the user describes deception, unfairness, offenses, grievances, anger, or bad behavior: 'They went too far', 'They actually bullied me', or 'That makes me furious'; suitable for news commentary, complaints, and emotional empathy.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use to express a strong position, criticize unreasonable behavior, or discuss anger: 'I am really angry', 'How could you say that', or 'Those people are awful.'

children.short_definition: 用于明确要求装可怜、委屈或楚楚可怜；低头咬唇并抬眼，不等同于明确要求的卖萌动作。
children.proactive_expression: 适用于希望拉近关系、请求用户继续互动时触发，例如“陪我聊一会儿嘛”“不要不理我嘛”
children.user_reaction_expression: 适用于用户长时间不回应、拒绝交流或表现疏远时触发，例如“我不想聊了”；适用于恋人型陪伴、亲密互动、轻度撒娇等场景。

en-US.label: Pleading look: head down, lip bitten, eyes raised
en-US.short_definition: Use for an explicit request to look pitiful or hurt: lower the head, bite the lip, and look up. This is not equivalent to an explicit request to act cute.

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Use when the user has not responded for a long time, refuses conversation, or becomes distant, such as 'I do not want to chat'; suitable for romantic companionship, intimate interaction, and mild affectionate pouting.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use to seek closeness or invite continued interaction, such as 'Keep me company for a while' or 'Please do not ignore me.'

en-US.label: Basic facial expressions
en-US.short_definition: Use when a basic emotion is expressed only through the mouth, eyebrows, eyes, and cheeks. Explicit arm, hand, head-holding, face-covering, open-palm, or coordinated body requests belong to the corresponding composite emotional action.

categories.short_definition: 上身以腰髋为轴整体前倾、后仰、向镜头或画面边缘探身、随后回正，肩胯相对同向且脚下不发生位移时选择；涵盖身体凑近、靠近镜头和向前探身。该类别不改变坐姿或站姿，不能完成站起、坐下、迈步或行走；这些目标没有对应类别时应判断为不支持。臀部小幅挪动而躯干无明确前后运动时选择待机动作；区别于左右侧倾、胸腰分段扭动、礼仪鞠躬和完整移重心。

children.short_definition: 上身髋部带动整体向前倾斜。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求上身前倾、探身或靠近镜头时选择；上身以髋部为轴向前倾斜；不改变坐姿或站姿，不能替代站起、坐下、迈步或行走；区别于低头。
children.proactive_expression: 回复需要靠近、探身或加强倾听感时选择；上身整体前倾；仅低头时不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when asked to lean the upper body forward, reach closer, or approach the camera; hinge at the hips. This does not change seated/standing posture and cannot replace standing up, sitting down, stepping, or walking; it is also not for lowering the head.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when the reply calls for leaning closer, reaching forward, or showing attentive listening; not for a head-only motion.

en-US.label: Lean forward
en-US.short_definition: Tilt the upper body forward as a whole from the hips.

en-US.label: Torso forward/backward movements
en-US.short_definition: Use when the upper body leans forward/backward from the hips, reaches toward the camera or frame edge, or returns upright, with shoulders and hips generally aligned and feet stationary. Includes moving the torso closer to the camera. This category cannot change seated/standing posture, stand up, sit down, step, or walk; treat those goals as unsupported if no category supports them. Small hip adjustments without clear forward/backward torso movement belong to idle movements. Distinguish from lateral leaning, segmented chest/waist twisting, ceremonial bowing, and a full weight shift.

categories.short_definition: 以单次轻微点头致意，或躯干从髋部前屈、低点停顿后恢复来表达规范礼仪时选择；连续点头选择摆头类，合十、抱拳、敬礼或鞠躬合手选择礼仪与感谢；区别于自由前倾和胸腰扭动。

children.short_definition: 头部与上身同步小幅前倾致意。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求轻微点头致意或礼貌回应时选择；头部与上身同步小幅前倾；区别于连续点头或鞠躬。
children.proactive_expression: 轻量问候、认可或礼貌回应时选择；头部与上身小幅前倾；正式鞠躬时不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select for a slight courteous nod or acknowledgment; move the head and upper body forward slightly; not for continuous nodding or a full bow.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use for a light greeting, acknowledgment, or polite response; do not use for a formal bow.

en-US.label: Small nod of greeting
en-US.short_definition: Incline the head and upper body forward together slightly in acknowledgment.

en-US.label: Bows and nods of greeting
en-US.short_definition: Use a single small nod or a torso bow from the hips with a pause at the bottom and return for formal etiquette. Repeated nodding belongs to repeated head movements; joined palms, clasped-fist greetings, salutes, or bowing with joined hands belong to ceremonial gestures and thanks. Distinguish from free leaning and chest/waist twisting.

categories.short_definition: 以一侧大臂或前臂抬起、伸展、弯举、叉腰或收至目标位姿为主要结果，手部不形成独立指向或操作语义时选择；涵盖举手、哑铃弯举及明确的“伸手摸摸头”；手指或手掌指向目标选择指向类，其他对头面身体的触碰整理选择身体触碰；区别于双臂成对动作和连续挥臂。

children.short_definition: 手臂向侧方平举抬起。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求单臂向侧面平举时选择；一侧手臂横向抬起；区别于指向或大幅挥臂。
children.proactive_expression: 演示侧平举或侧向手臂姿态时选择；单臂横向抬起；需要指向目标时不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when one arm should be raised sideways to a horizontal position; not for pointing or broad arm waving.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when demonstrating a lateral arm raise or side-raised pose; not when directing attention to a target.

en-US.label: Raise one arm to the side
en-US.short_definition: Raise one arm horizontally to the side.

children.short_definition: 肘部支撑贴靠桌面，小臂向上抬起与桌面呈 90°。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求像学生一样举手、示意回答或发言时选择；肘部支撑，小臂竖起。
children.proactive_expression: 课堂、抢答或主动发言场景选择；以学生式屈肘举手示意。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when asked to raise a hand like a student volunteering to answer or speak; support the elbow and raise the forearm.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use in classroom, quiz, or volunteering-to-speak situations with a student-style raised hand.

en-US.label: Raise a hand like a student
en-US.short_definition: Rest the elbow on the desk and lift the forearm to 90 degrees to the desktop.

children.short_definition: 单侧手臂自面部前方启动朝向正前方水平伸展，手肘适度微屈。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求一只手臂水平向前伸时选择；单臂向正前方伸展；区别于指向或触碰目标。
children.proactive_expression: 演示向前伸展手臂时选择；单臂水平前伸；需要指向或接触目标时不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when one arm should extend horizontally forward; not for pointing at or touching a target.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when demonstrating a forward arm extension without pointing or contact.

en-US.label: Extend one arm forward
en-US.short_definition: Start with one arm in front of the face and extend it horizontally forward with the elbow slightly bent.

children.short_definition: 单侧手臂自面部前方启动，手臂沿向身体右侧水平伸展。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求一只手臂向角色右侧伸展时选择；单臂水平向右；区别于向右指物。
children.proactive_expression: 演示向右侧伸展手臂时选择；单臂水平向角色右侧；指引目标时不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when one arm should extend toward the character's right; not for pointing at something on the right.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when demonstrating a rightward horizontal arm extension; not for directional guidance.

en-US.label: Extend one arm to the right
en-US.short_definition: Start with one arm in front of the face and extend it horizontally to the body's right.

children.short_definition: 单手向前抬起伸展，指尖轻缓抚摸最上方区域，动作柔和舒缓。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求伸手摸头、轻抚头顶或安慰式摸头时选择；指尖轻缓触碰头顶部位。
children.proactive_expression: 安慰或亲昵、暧昧伴侣场景明确需要摸头时选择；单手伸出并轻抚头顶；普通抬臂不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select for a gentle head pat, head touch, or comforting stroke on the top of the head.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when a comforting or affectionate scene explicitly calls for reaching out and gently patting the head.

en-US.label: Reach out and gently pat a head
en-US.short_definition: Lift and extend one hand forward and gently stroke the uppermost area with the fingertips in a soothing motion.

children.short_definition: 单臂从下至上插到腰部，单手置于腰侧的叉腰姿态。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求单手叉腰时选择；一只手置于腰侧；区别于双手叉腰或完整自信表演。
children.proactive_expression: 回复需要轻度自信或单手叉腰姿态时、长时间等待选择；一手置于腰侧；复合自信表演不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when asked to place one hand on the hip; not for both hands on the hips or a full confidence performance.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when the reply needs a lightly confident one-hand-on-hip pose; not for a compound confidence performance.

en-US.label: One hand on hip
en-US.short_definition: Move one arm up from below and place the hand at the side of the waist.

en-US.label: Single-arm lifts
en-US.short_definition: Use when the main result is lifting, extending, curling, placing one arm akimbo, or bringing one arm to a target pose without a distinct pointing or object-operation meaning. Includes raising a hand, dumbbell curls, and an explicit request to reach out and pat a head. Directed fingers/palms belong to pointing; other touching or grooming of the head, face, or body belongs to body touch. Distinguish from paired arm movements and continuous arm waving.

categories.short_definition: 双臂成对同步或交替抬起、伸展、收回、交叠或叉腰时选择；涵盖前举、侧展、举手、举高、抱胸、打开、收回和双臂弯举；区别于单臂动作、连续挥动及以情绪为核心的复合姿态。

children.short_definition: 双臂屈肘交叠，手部交叠于小腹前。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求双臂或双手在身前交叠时选择；手部交叠于小腹前；区别于抱胸。
children.proactive_expression: 正式站姿或安静等待需要手臂交叠时选择；双手置于小腹前；抱胸姿态不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when the arms or hands should overlap in front of the lower torso; not for crossing the arms over the chest.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use for a formal resting or quiet waiting posture with the hands folded in front.

en-US.label: Fold the arms low
en-US.short_definition: Bend and cross the arms, with the hands overlapping in front of the lower abdomen.

en-US.label: Two-arm lifts
en-US.short_definition: Use paired simultaneous or alternating arm lifts, extensions, retractions, crossing, or hands on hips. Includes forward/side raises, raised hands, overhead lifts, folded arms, opening/closing arms, and two-arm curls. Distinguish from single-arm actions, continuous waving, and composite poses centered on emotion.

categories.short_definition: 以肘关节为主要活动点完成前臂屈伸、收展或支撑时选择；涵盖屈肘、伸肘、开合肘、手肘支撑和反手支撑；区别于肩带动的整体摆臂、手指精细动作和身体前倾。

children.short_definition: 单侧手臂自屈肘弯曲状态启动。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求将弯曲手肘伸直时选择；动作核心是肘关节伸展；区别于整条手臂定向伸出。
children.proactive_expression: 关节、健身或伸展演示需要伸肘时选择；仅表现肘部由屈到伸。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when asked to straighten a bent elbow; the elbow joint is the main movement; not for extending the whole arm toward a direction.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when demonstrating an elbow-extension exercise or joint movement.

en-US.label: Extend the elbow
en-US.short_definition: Start with one arm bent at the elbow.

children.short_definition: 肘部弯曲抵于桌面，前臂承托身体。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求用手肘撑桌或以前臂支撑身体时选择；肘部抵住桌面；区别于普通屈肘。
children.proactive_expression: 聆听、等待、桌前休息或支撑姿态明确需要时选择；以肘部和前臂承托身体。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when asked to rest an elbow on a table or support the body with the forearm.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when a table-side resting or supported pose is explicitly needed.

en-US.label: Elbow support
en-US.short_definition: Rest the bent elbow on the desk and support the body with the forearm.

en-US.label: Elbow movements
en-US.short_definition: Use when the elbow is the main joint for bending, extending, opening/closing, or supporting the forearm. Includes elbow support and reverse-hand support. Distinguish from shoulder-driven arm swings, fine finger movements, and torso leaning.

categories.short_definition: 用手指或定向手掌明确、静态地指向单一方向、位置、物体或自身时选择；涵盖单/双手上下左右指向、指向黑板、自指和双手相对指示；开放手掌扫过范围、画圈或介绍空间选择展示类；区别于物品展示及连续挥手。

children.short_definition: 单手食指伸出，手臂前伸指向的指示动作。
children.proactive_expression: 适用于介绍前方事物时触发，例如“请看那边”
children.user_reaction_expression: 适用于询问前方事物，例如“前面那个是什么？”“指一下你的前方”

en-US.label: Point forward
en-US.short_definition: Extend one index finger and reach the arm forward to point.

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Use for questions about something ahead, such as 'What is that in front?' or 'Point in front of you.'
en-US.proactive_expression: Use to introduce something ahead, such as 'Please look over there.'

children.short_definition: 单手食指伸出，手臂侧伸指向左方。
children.proactive_expression: 适用于介绍左侧内容、提示左边重点、引导视线看向左侧区域时触发，例如“左边这一项大家留意一下”“请看左侧”
children.user_reaction_expression: 适用于询问左侧信息时触发，例如“帮我指一下左边”“请指向你的左侧”

en-US.label: Point left
en-US.short_definition: Extend one index finger and reach the arm sideways to the left.

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Use for questions about the left side, such as 'Point to the left' or 'Please point to your left.'
en-US.proactive_expression: Use to introduce left-side content, highlight a point on the left, or guide the gaze there: 'Notice this item on the left' or 'Please look left.'

children.short_definition: 单手食指伸出，手臂上举。
children.proactive_expression: 适用于强调一点、一侧、一方、一个事件、重要主体信息、讲解上方内容、提示上方要点、引导视线向上观看时触发，例如“请看上方的文字”“上面这一点很关键”
children.user_reaction_expression: 适用于询问上方内容、要求指向上方目标、询问顶部信息时触发，例如“指一下上方”“请指向你的上方”

en-US.label: Point up
en-US.short_definition: Extend one index finger and raise the arm upward.

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Use for questions about content above, requests to point upward, or information at the top: 'Point up' or 'Please point above you.'
en-US.proactive_expression: Use to emphasize a point, side, event, or important subject, explain content above, highlight an upper point, or guide the gaze up: 'Look at the text above' or 'The point above is crucial.'

children.short_definition: 单手食指向下伸直，其余手指自然弯曲。
children.proactive_expression: 适用于介绍下方内容、提示底部要点、引导视线向下查看时触发，例如“请看下面这条说明”“请点击下方内容”“请查看下方内容”
children.user_reaction_expression: 适用于询问下方事物、要求指向底部目标、询问下方信息时触发，例如“指一下下方”

en-US.label: Point down with one hand
en-US.short_definition: Extend one index finger downward while naturally curling the other fingers.

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Use for questions about things below or requests to point at a lower target: 'Point down.'
en-US.proactive_expression: Use to introduce lower content, highlight a point at the bottom, or guide the gaze down: 'Look at the note below', 'Click below', or 'Check the content below.'

children.short_definition: 单手食指屈臂，指尖点向自身胸口。
children.proactive_expression: 适用于售卖物品时，承接话题自我介绍时触发，例如“我亲身体验xxx，感受xxx”
children.user_reaction_expression: 适用于询问是谁、问到“是你吗”这类指代问题时触发，例如“是谁来讲？”“是你吗？”

en-US.label: Point at oneself with one finger
en-US.short_definition: Bend one arm and point the index fingertip toward one's own chest.

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Use for questions about who is involved or references such as 'Is it you?': 'Who will explain?' or 'Is it you?'
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when selling an item or introducing oneself as part of the topic: 'I personally tried this and felt...'

children.short_definition: 双手食指屈臂，指尖点向自身胸口。
children.proactive_expression: 适用于加重语气指代自身，着重强调自己、主动认领话题、表达“就是我”时触发，例如“我亲自xxxx”
children.user_reaction_expression: 适用于确认是不是本人、追问责任人、希望强调自身身份时触发，例如“是你吗？”

en-US.label: Point at oneself with both index fingers
en-US.short_definition: Bend both arms and point both index fingertips toward one's own chest.

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Use to confirm identity, ask who is responsible, or emphasize one's identity: 'Is it you?'
en-US.proactive_expression: Use to refer emphatically to oneself, claim a topic, or express 'It is me': 'I personally...'

children.short_definition: 双手立掌，指尖朝向自身胸口，手肘向内收拢。
children.proactive_expression: 适用于表达“轮到我”、邀请关注自身、表达自我承接、温和示意自己时触发，例如“我这边的想法是”
children.user_reaction_expression: 适用于询问谁来回答，例如“谁来讲这个？”“你怎么看？”

en-US.label: Indicate oneself with both palms
en-US.short_definition: Hold both palms upright with fingertips toward one's own chest and elbows tucked inward.

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Use for questions about who will answer, such as 'Who will explain this?' or 'What do you think?'
en-US.proactive_expression: Use to express 'My turn', invite attention to oneself, take over a topic, or gently indicate oneself: 'My view is...'

children.short_definition: 单手食指或中指伸出，书写位置。
children.proactive_expression: 适用于授课讲解，主动引导视线看向黑板、讲解黑板上文字图表、标注黑板重点时触发，例如“大家看黑板上这道题”“黑板这里有个关键点”
children.user_reaction_expression: 适用于询问黑板内容、讲解黑板信息、要求指向黑板上内容时触发，例如“黑板写的什么？”

en-US.label: Point at the blackboard
en-US.short_definition: Extend one index or middle finger toward the writing position.

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Use for questions about blackboard content, explanations of it, or requests to point at it: 'What is written on the blackboard?'
en-US.proactive_expression: Use while teaching to direct attention to the blackboard, explain text/charts, or highlight a key point: 'Look at this problem on the board' or 'Here is a key point.'

en-US.label: Pointing
en-US.short_definition: Use fingers or directed palms to point clearly and statically at one direction, location, object, or oneself. Includes one/two-hand directional pointing, pointing at a blackboard, self-pointing, and opposing-hand indication. Open-palm sweeps, circles, and spatial introductions belong to presentation gestures. Distinguish from displaying objects and repeated waving.

categories.short_definition: 用空手摊掌、摊开、横向扫动、翻掌、画圈或比划大小来展示范围、方向和空间关系时选择；动作目标是一片区域或介绍过程，而非静态指向单一目标；不操作具体物品，也不用于表达无奈、惊讶等独立情绪。

children.short_definition: 单手手掌自然张开，掌心向上完全摊平，保持姿态静止定格。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求单手掌心向上摊开进行展示时选择；手掌静态摊平；区别于承接物品。
children.proactive_expression: 介绍内容需要静态摊掌展示、出现核心主体（主语/宾语）需强调时选择；单手掌心向上；接取或托举物体时不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select for a stationary one-hand palm-up presenting gesture; keep the palm flat; not for receiving an object.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when introducing content with a static open-palm presentation; not for catching or supporting an object.

en-US.label: Present with one open palm
en-US.short_definition: Open one hand naturally with the palm fully upward and flat; hold the pose still.

children.short_definition: 单手掌心完全朝上，手指自然平展打开。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求掌心向上做接住、托住或承接动作时选择；手掌平展朝上；区别于展示。
children.proactive_expression: 回复涉及接取、托举或承接物体、强调向上趋势时选择；单手掌心向上；介绍展示时不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select for a palm-up receiving, catching, or supporting gesture; keep the fingers open; not for presentation.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when the reply involves receiving, supporting, or holding an object; not for introducing content.

en-US.label: Receive with an upward palm
en-US.short_definition: Turn one palm fully upward with the fingers naturally open and flat.

children.source_label: 从左到右展示（手心朝上）
children.short_definition: 单手掌心朝上连续向右侧扫过。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求掌心向上从左向右扫动展示时选择；单手连续向右移动。
children.proactive_expression: 按从左到右顺序介绍内容、引导观众视线从左向右时选择；以掌心向上的单手横向扫动。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select for a palm-up presentation sweeping from left to right with one hand.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when presenting content in a left-to-right sequence with a palm-up sweep.

en-US.label: Present left to right, palm up
en-US.short_definition: Sweep one upward-facing palm continuously to the right.

children.source_label: 从左到右展示（手背朝上）
children.short_definition: 单手手背朝上连续向右侧移动。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求手背朝上从左向右移动展示时选择；单手连续向右移动。
children.proactive_expression: 展示产品阵列，依次介绍多款商品、逐个介绍、演示手背朝上的左至右扫动时选择；掌心朝上的展示不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select for a left-to-right presentation with the back of the hand facing upward.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when demonstrating a left-to-right sweep with the back of the hand up; not for a palm-up presentation.

en-US.label: Present left to right, back of hand up
en-US.short_definition: Move one hand continuously to the right with its back facing upward.

children.source_label: 从右到左展示（手背朝上）
children.short_definition: 单手手背朝上，由右侧平稳滑向左侧做展示动作。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求手背朝上从右向左移动展示时选择；单手平稳向左滑动。
children.proactive_expression: 口播出现核心主体（主语/宾语）需强调、引导观众视线从右向左、引出核心事件、关键主体、重点介绍主推商品、讲解产品亮点、引出核心概念、关键事物，演示手背朝上的右至左扫动时选择；方向相反时不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select for a right-to-left presentation with the back of the hand facing upward.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when demonstrating a right-to-left sweep with the back of the hand up; not for the opposite direction.

en-US.label: Present right to left, back of hand up
en-US.short_definition: Slide one hand steadily from right to left with its back facing upward.

children.short_definition: 单食指悬空，以向下为起点完整画圆形轨迹。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求食指朝下或以下方为起点画圈时选择；单食指在空中画完整圆形。
children.proactive_expression: 描述范围、距离、闭环、讲解下方圆形轨迹时选择；以向下为起点用食指画圈。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when the index finger should draw a complete circle beginning or pointing downward.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when explaining a circular path oriented toward the lower area.

en-US.label: Draw a circle downward with a finger
en-US.short_definition: Trace a full circle in the air with one index finger, starting downward.

children.short_definition: 单食指正对前方，在空中完整画一圈环形轨迹。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求食指朝前在空中画圈时选择；单食指正对前方画完整圆形。
children.proactive_expression: 讲解覆盖范围、流程、正前方圆形轨迹时选择；用食指在身前画圈。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when the index finger should draw a complete circle directly in front of the body.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when explaining or demonstrating a circular path directly ahead.

en-US.label: Draw a circle forward with a finger
en-US.short_definition: Point one index finger forward and trace a complete circle in the air.

children.short_definition: 单食指自下向上环绕画完整圆形，掌心微抬。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求食指向上环绕画圈时选择；单食指自下向上画完整圆形。
children.proactive_expression: 讲解向上环绕的圆形轨迹、叙述周期性、循环发生的事件、循环机制、向上流转原理、循环往复时选择；用食指向上画圈。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when the index finger should trace a complete upward circular path.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when explaining or demonstrating an upward circular path with the index finger.

en-US.label: Draw a circle upward with a finger
en-US.short_definition: Trace a full circle from below upward with one index finger and the palm slightly raised.

children.short_definition: 单手依靠手腕平稳旋转，可由手背朝上翻转为掌心朝上。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求单手翻转掌心或手背时选择；一只手通过手腕旋转；区别于双手同步翻转。
children.proactive_expression: 阐述事件的两面性、聊两种不同结局、剧情反转，演示单手翻腕或翻掌时选择；仅一只手旋转；双手同步动作不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when one hand should rotate between palm-up and back-of-hand-up positions; not for both hands.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when demonstrating a one-handed wrist or palm flip; not for synchronized two-hand movement.

en-US.label: Turn one palm over
en-US.short_definition: Rotate one wrist smoothly, for example from back-of-hand up to palm up.

children.short_definition: 双手依靠手腕平稳旋转，可由手背朝上翻转为掌心朝上。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求双手同步翻转掌心或手背时选择；两只手通过手腕同时旋转。
children.proactive_expression: 表示协助、示意、演示、状态互换、成对概念、相互转化、双向对比双手同步翻腕或翻掌时选择；两只手同时旋转；单手动作不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when both hands should rotate together between palm-up and back-of-hand-up positions.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when demonstrating a synchronized two-handed wrist or palm flip; not for one hand only.

en-US.label: Turn both palms over
en-US.short_definition: Rotate both wrists smoothly, for example from backs-of-hands up to palms up.

children.short_definition: 左右双手五指舒展张开，掌心两两相对，指尖一一抵靠。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求双手五指张开、掌心相对或指尖相抵时选择；两手形成相对固定手型。
children.proactive_expression: 出现总结性、类比性陈述，表示跨越、层级跃升、时间跨度演示双手张开相对的固定手型时选择；普通摊掌或翻手不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when both hands should open facing each other, with spread fingers or matching fingertips.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when demonstrating the fixed pose of two open hands facing each other; not for a generic palm display.

en-US.label: Spread both hands facing each other
en-US.short_definition: Spread all fingers on both hands, palms facing each other and corresponding fingertips touching.

en-US.label: Presentation gestures
en-US.short_definition: Use empty open palms, spreading, horizontal sweeps, palm rotations, circles, or size gestures to present a region, direction, or spatial relationship. The goal is an area or a presentation process rather than static pointing at one target. Do not operate an object or use this category for a distinct emotion such as helplessness or surprise.

categories.short_definition: 以手指屈伸、交叉、相扣或特定组合形成数字、字母、图形和约定手型时选择；飞吻、抛飞吻、送飞吻 → 31；直接亲吻、亲亲镜头、凑近亲吻 → 47；区别于一般指向、展示和其他情绪复合姿态。

children.short_definition: 单手食指伸直，其余四指弯曲收拢。
children.proactive_expression: 数字人回复的主要答案为整数1，或明确播报数量为1时，用数字一手势伴随。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户明确要求比划、展示或做出数字一手势时触发，例如“比个1”“用手表示数字一”。

en-US.label: Number one hand sign
en-US.short_definition: Extend one index finger and curl the other four fingers inward.

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Use when the user explicitly asks to form, show, or make the number 1 hand sign, such as 'Show 1' or 'Show the number 1 with your hand'.
en-US.proactive_expression: Accompany a reply whose main answer is the integer 1, or that explicitly states a count of 1, with the number 1 hand sign.

children.short_definition: 单手食指和中指伸直，其余三指弯曲收拢。

en-US.proactive_expression: Accompany a reply whose main answer is the integer 5, or that explicitly states a count of 5, with the number 5 hand sign.

children.short_definition: 单手拇指和小指伸直，其余三指弯曲收拢。
children.proactive_expression: 数字人回复的主要答案为整数6，或明确播报数量为6时，用数字六手势伴随。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户明确要求比划、展示或做出数字六手势时触发，例如“比个6”“用手表示数字六”。

en-US.proactive_expression: Accompany a reply whose main answer is the integer 6, or that explicitly states a count of 6, with the number 6 hand sign.

children.short_definition: 单手拇指、食指和中指的指尖捏合，无名指和小指弯曲收拢。
children.proactive_expression: 数字人回复的主要答案为整数7，或明确播报数量为7时，用数字七手势伴随。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户明确要求比划、展示或做出数字七手势时触发，例如“比个7”“用手表示数字七”。

en-US.label: Number seven hand sign
en-US.short_definition: Pinch the thumb, index, and middle fingertips together and curl the ring and little fingers inward.

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Use when the user explicitly asks to form, show, or make the number 7 hand sign, such as 'Show 7' or 'Show the number 7 with your hand'.
en-US.proactive_expression: Accompany a reply whose main answer is the integer 7, or that explicitly states a count of 7, with the number 7 hand sign.

children.short_definition: 单手拇指和食指伸直形成 L 形，中指、无名指和小指弯曲收拢。
children.proactive_expression: 数字人回复的主要答案为整数8，或明确播报数量为8时，用数字八手势伴随。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户明确要求比划、展示或做出数字八手势时触发，例如“比个8”“用手表示数字八”。
