en-US.short_definition: Extend the thumb and index finger in an L shape and curl the middle, ring, and little fingers inward.

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Use when the user explicitly asks to form, show, or make the number 8 hand sign, such as 'Show 8' or 'Show the number 8 with your hand'.
en-US.proactive_expression: Accompany a reply whose main answer is the integer 8, or that explicitly states a count of 8, with the number 8 hand sign.

children.short_definition: 单手食指弯曲成钩状，中指、无名指和小指收拢，拇指内扣贴于掌心。
children.proactive_expression: 数字人回复的主要答案为整数9，或明确播报数量为9时，用数字九手势伴随。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户明确要求比划、展示或做出数字九手势时触发，例如“比个9”“用手表示数字九”。

en-US.label: Number nine hand sign
en-US.short_definition: Bend one index finger into a hook, curl the middle, ring, and little fingers inward, and fold the thumb against the palm.

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Use when the user explicitly asks to form, show, or make the number 9 hand sign, such as 'Show 9' or 'Show the number 9 with your hand'.
en-US.proactive_expression: Accompany a reply whose main answer is the integer 9, or that explicitly states a count of 9, with the number 9 hand sign.

children.short_definition: 单手拇指与食指弯成C形，其余指收拢。
children.proactive_expression: 适用于讲解字母C、描述弧形物体、示意单侧括号、勾勒单侧轮廓时触发，例如“这是字母C”
children.user_reaction_expression: 适用于要求比划字母C、描述弧形物体、示意单侧括号轮廓时触发，例如“帮我比个C”

en-US.label: One-hand C sign
en-US.short_definition: Curve the thumb and index finger into a C shape and curl the other fingers inward.

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Use for a request to form the letter C, describe a curved object, or indicate a single bracket outline, such as 'Make a C for me'.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use to explain the letter C, describe a curved object, indicate a single bracket, or outline one side, such as 'This is the letter C'.

children.short_definition: 两手拇指与食指分别弯成C形。
children.proactive_expression: 适用于讲解左右括号、勾勒物体两侧轮廓、对比两侧弧形结构时触发，例如“两边就是一对括号”
children.user_reaction_expression: 适用于要求比划一对括号、用双手比字母C、比划物品大小、勾勒物体两侧轮廓、对比两侧弧形结构时触发，例如“用手比一对括号”

en-US.label: Two-hand C signs
en-US.short_definition: Curve the thumb and index finger of each hand into a C shape.

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Use for a request to form paired brackets, make Cs with both hands, indicate an object's size, outline both sides of an object, or compare curved structures on both sides, such as 'Make a pair of brackets with your hands'.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use to explain left/right brackets, outline both sides of an object, or compare curved structures on both sides, such as 'The two sides form a pair of brackets'.

children.short_definition: 手握空拳，拇指单独竖起向前的手势。
children.proactive_expression: 适用于表达认可、夸奖、肯定内容、赞许用户观点时触发，例如“这个想法很棒”、“太棒了”
children.user_reaction_expression: 适用于分享成果、表达观点、期待得到肯定，或者要求点赞时触发，例如“你觉得我做得怎么样？”

en-US.label: One thumbs-up
en-US.short_definition: Loosely close one hand into a fist and extend the thumb upward.

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Use when the user shares an achievement or opinion, seeks approval, or requests a thumbs-up, such as 'How do you think I did?'
en-US.proactive_expression: Use to express approval, praise, affirmation, or agreement with the user's view, such as 'That is a great idea' or 'Excellent'.

children.short_definition: 双手握拳，拇指同步竖起向前的点赞手势。
children.proactive_expression: 适用于着重表达强烈认可、高度赞赏、大力肯定用户成果时触发，例如“非常厉害，值得肯定！”
children.user_reaction_expression: 适用于分享重大成就、希望获得强烈赞许，要求双手点赞时触发，例如“快给我一个大大的赞”

en-US.label: Two thumbs-up
en-US.short_definition: Loosely close both hands into fists and extend both thumbs upward.

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Use when the user shares a major achievement, seeks strong praise, or requests two thumbs-up, such as 'Give me a big thumbs-up'.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use to emphasize strong approval, high praise, or firm affirmation of the user's achievement, such as 'Very impressive, well deserved!'.

children.short_definition: 食指中指伸出成V，其余手指收拢的比耶手势。
children.proactive_expression: 适用于表达开心、庆祝、胜利、传递轻松愉快氛围时触发，例如“太棒啦”、“成功啦”、“比个耶”
children.user_reaction_expression: 适用于分享喜事、庆祝胜利、要求比耶手势互动时触发，例如“帮我比个耶”、“比个耶”

en-US.label: One peace sign
en-US.short_definition: Extend the index and middle fingers in a V and curl the other fingers inward.

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Use for happy news, celebrating victory, or a request for a peace sign, such as 'Give me a peace sign.'
en-US.proactive_expression: Use to express happiness, celebration, victory, or a relaxed cheerful mood: 'Awesome', 'We did it', or 'Peace!'

children.short_definition: 双手食指中指伸出成V，举于身前的比耶手势。
children.proactive_expression: 适用于表达强烈喜悦、庆祝重大喜事、烘托热烈欢快氛围时触发，例如“恭喜，圆满成功！”“双手比耶”
children.user_reaction_expression: 适用于分享重大喜讯、庆祝重要时刻，要求双手比耶时触发，例如“来个双手耶庆祝一下”、“双手比耶”

en-US.label: Two peace signs
en-US.short_definition: Extend both index and middle fingers into V shapes and hold both hands in front of the body.

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Use for major good news, an important celebration, or a request for two peace signs: 'Celebrate with two peace signs.'
en-US.proactive_expression: Use for strong joy, major celebrations, or an exuberant atmosphere: 'Congratulations, a complete success!' or 'Two peace signs!'

children.short_definition: 双手比出V字，分置脸颊两侧的比耶手势。
children.proactive_expression: 适用于拍照互动、着重卖萌、营造活泼可爱的强氛围感时触发，例如“准备好拍照咯”、“双手在脸庞比个耶”
children.user_reaction_expression: 适用于提议合影、想要可爱互动手势，要求双手在脸颊两侧比耶时触发，例如“两边都比耶拍照”、“双手在脸庞比个耶”

en-US.label: Peace signs beside both cheeks
en-US.short_definition: Form a V with each hand and place them on either side of the cheeks.

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Use for a photo, a cute interactive gesture, or a request for peace signs beside both cheeks: 'Peace signs on both sides for the photo.'
en-US.proactive_expression: Use for photo interaction, emphatic cuteness, or a lively cute atmosphere: 'Ready for the photo' or 'Peace signs beside both cheeks.'

children.short_definition: 手指比出V字，手腕小幅左右摆动。
children.proactive_expression: 适用于轻松俏皮互动、欢快打招呼、拍照时动态卖萌时触发，例如“嗨，看这里”
children.user_reaction_expression: 适用于想要动态可爱手势互动、拍照互动，要求摆动比耶手势时触发，例如“晃动一下耶的手势”

en-US.label: Sway a peace sign
en-US.short_definition: Form a V with the fingers and gently sway the wrist side to side.

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Use for a dynamic cute gesture, photo interaction, or a request to sway a peace sign: 'Wiggle your peace sign.'
en-US.proactive_expression: Use for playful interaction, a cheerful greeting, or animated cuteness in a photo: 'Hi, look here.'

children.short_definition: 双手置于头部两侧，拇指与食指并拢竖起模拟兔耳。
children.proactive_expression: 适用于卖萌、角色扮演、可爱趣味互动、讲故事扮演小动物时触发，例如“看，小兔子来啦”
children.user_reaction_expression: 适用于想要可爱动物手势互动、要求比兔子耳朵、玩角色扮演时触发，例如“比个小兔子耳朵”

en-US.label: Bunny-ear gesture
en-US.short_definition: Place both hands beside the head, holding each thumb and index finger together upright to imitate rabbit ears.

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Use for cute animal gestures, a request for bunny ears, or roleplay: 'Make bunny ears.'
en-US.proactive_expression: Use for cuteness, roleplay, playful interaction, or acting as a small animal in a story: 'Look, here comes a bunny.'

children.short_definition: 双手弯曲相扣，比出完整爱心形状的比心手势。
children.proactive_expression: 适用于表达喜爱、传递好感、表达感谢、送出祝福时触发，例如“送给你一颗小心心”、“给你我的爱”、“爱你哦”
children.user_reaction_expression: 适用于期待收到爱心、表达喜欢，要求比爱心手势时触发，例如“给我比个爱心”、“双手比个心”

en-US.label: Two-hand heart
en-US.short_definition: Curve and join both hands to form a complete heart shape.

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Use when the user wants a heart, expresses affection, or asks for a heart gesture: 'Make a heart for me' or 'Make a heart with both hands.'
en-US.proactive_expression: Use to express affection, fondness, thanks, or good wishes: 'Here is a little heart for you', 'Here is my love', or 'Love you.'

children.short_definition: 指尖轻触唇边，随即向前扬手抛出的飞吻动作。
children.proactive_expression: 适用于表达亲昵、送出甜蜜祝福、温柔道别时触发，例如“送你一个飞吻”、“爱你哦”
children.user_reaction_expression: 适用于索要飞吻、期待亲昵互动，要求做飞吻动作时触发，例如“给我一个飞吻吧”、“给我飞吻”

en-US.label: Blow a kiss with one hand
en-US.short_definition: Lightly touch the lips with the fingertips, then flick the hand forward to send a kiss.

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Use when asked for a blown kiss or affectionate interaction: 'Blow me a kiss.'
en-US.proactive_expression: Use to express affection, send sweet wishes, or say a gentle farewell: 'Sending you a kiss' or 'Love you.'

en-US.label: Symbolic hand gestures
en-US.short_definition: Use finger configurations to form numbers, letters, shapes, or conventional signs. Blowing or sending a kiss belongs to category 31; direct kissing, kissing the camera, or leaning in for a kiss belongs to category 47. Distinguish from ordinary pointing, presentation, and other composite emotional poses.

categories.short_definition: 面向他人以手掌向外做小幅稳定往复摆动，表达打招呼、问候、告别、回应、自我介绍、说明身份或初次建立关系时选择；涵盖单手和双手挥手；区别于请求靠近的招引、手臂大幅挥击及单纯动作展示。

children.short_definition: 单手抬起位于身前或举高，手掌面向外部左右摆动的打招呼动作。
children.proactive_expression: 适用于问候用户、开场打招呼、结束对话道别、回应用户问候时触发，例如“你好，欢迎来到直播间”“再见啦”
children.user_reaction_expression: 适用于问好、道别、挥手打招呼，要求挥手回应时触发，例如“嗨”“拜拜”“你好”

en-US.label: Wave with one hand
en-US.short_definition: Raise one hand in front of the body or higher, palm outward, and wave it side to side in greeting.

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Use for greetings, farewells, or requests to wave back: 'Hi', 'Bye', or 'Hello.'
en-US.proactive_expression: Use to greet the user, open a conversation, say farewell, or return a greeting: 'Hello, welcome to my livestream' or 'Goodbye.'

en-US.label: Greetings and farewells
en-US.short_definition: Use small steady side-to-side waves with outward-facing palms to greet, say farewell, respond, introduce oneself, explain identity, or establish a first connection. Includes one/two-hand waves. Distinguish from beckoning someone closer, large arm swings, and simple action demonstrations.

categories.short_definition: 以短促下压、握拳、拍击、数指、推掌或交叉拒绝来强化口头立场、讲解、停止或否定时选择；即使使用握拳或手指动作，只要核心目的是加强话语就归本类；无表达目的的局部手指操作选择手指精细动作，鼓劲欢呼选择鼓励与庆祝。

children.short_definition: 单手掌心向下，短促下压后停顿的强调动作。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求单手下压进行强调时选择；掌心向下短促下压；区别于加油或停止手势。
children.proactive_expression: 出现定语+中心名词、状语+宾语、并列动词、因果连词，回复需要以下压动作强化语气或重要内容时选择；单手掌心向下；鼓励或制止场景不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select for a short one-hand downward palm motion that emphasizes a point; not for cheering or signaling stop.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when the reply needs a downward hand motion to reinforce a point; not for encouragement or prevention.

en-US.label: Press one hand down for emphasis
en-US.short_definition: With one palm downward, make a brief downward press and pause.

children.short_definition: 五指收拢握拳，短促轻晃示意的强调动作。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求轻握拳强调观点时选择；拳头短促轻晃；区别于握拳加油或静态握拳。
children.proactive_expression: 回复需要用轻握拳加强立场时选择；拳头小幅晃动；鼓励场景不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select for a lightly clenched fist that briefly moves to emphasize a point; not for cheering or a static fist.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when the reply needs mild stance emphasis with a lightly moving fist; not for encouragement.

en-US.label: Small fist gesture for emphasis
en-US.short_definition: Close the fingers into a fist and give a short gentle shake for emphasis.

children.short_definition: 单手向上抬起，短促向下发力，单次或上下反复拍击实体桌。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求单手拍桌强调时选择；一只手短促拍击实体桌面；没有桌面时不得选择。
children.proactive_expression: 有桌面且回复需要强烈强调时选择；以单手拍桌；普通手臂下压不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select only for a requested one-hand table slap used for emphasis; a physical table must be available or specified.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use only when a table is available and the reply requires strong one-handed emphasis.

en-US.label: Slap the table with one hand
en-US.short_definition: Lift one hand and strike a physical table downward briefly, once or repeatedly.

children.short_definition: 双手向上抬起，短促向下发力，单次或上下反复拍击实体桌。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求双手拍桌强调时选择；两只手短促拍击实体桌面；没有桌面时不得选择。
children.proactive_expression: 有桌面且需要更强烈强调时选择；以双手拍桌；单手要求不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select only for a requested two-hand table slap used for emphasis; a physical table must be available or specified.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use only when a table is available and the reply requires stronger two-handed emphasis.

en-US.label: Slap the table with both hands
en-US.short_definition: Lift both hands and strike a physical table downward briefly, once or repeatedly.

children.short_definition: 双掌相对置于胸前，随腕部同步旋转。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求双掌相对并同步旋转或摇晃时选择；动作核心是双腕同时旋转。
children.proactive_expression: 出现共同、表过渡示意，表示关系问题，演示双手相对旋转时选择；双掌置于胸前并随手腕同步转动。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when both palms should face each other and rotate or sway together; the wrists rotate in sync.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when explicitly demonstrating synchronized rotation of two facing hands.

en-US.label: Rotate both hands facing each other
en-US.short_definition: Hold the palms facing each other in front of the chest and rotate the wrists together.

children.short_definition: 单手立掌向前推出，随后短暂停住。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求立掌前推表示停止、拒绝或别靠近时选择；单手向前推出并停住。
children.proactive_expression: 回复明确表达停止、拒绝或制止时选择；以立掌前推强化含义。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select for a forward open-palm gesture meaning stop, refuse, or keep away; push one palm forward and pause.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when the reply clearly expresses stopping, refusal, or prevention with a forward palm.

en-US.label: Push a palm forward to stop
en-US.short_definition: Push one upright palm forward and hold briefly.

en-US.label: Emphasis gestures
en-US.short_definition: Use brief downward presses, fists, slaps, finger counting, palm pushes, or crossed-arm rejection to emphasize speech, explanation, stopping, or denial. Fist/finger actions belong here when their core purpose is strengthening speech. Finger operations without an expressive purpose belong to fine finger movements; cheering belongs to encouragement and celebration.

categories.short_definition: 以拍手、握拳、挥臂或击掌这一主要手势表达鼓励、欢呼或庆祝时选择；涵盖鼓掌、加油、振臂欢呼和击掌；若双脚、头部、表情与双手按顺序组成完整情绪表演，选择情绪动作；区别于强调、请求引导及无情绪的手臂抬举。

children.short_definition: 单手握拳前举，手臂短促用力挥动的加油动作。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求加油、鼓劲或助威时选择；单手握拳前举并短促挥动；区别于一般强调。
children.proactive_expression: 鼓励用户或表达支持时选择；以单手握拳短促挥动；普通强调不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select for encouragement, support, or cheering with one short fist pump; not for ordinary emphasis.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when encouraging the user or expressing support with a short one-fist pump; not for general emphasis.

en-US.label: Fist pump for encouragement
en-US.short_definition: Raise one fist forward and pump the arm briefly and firmly to encourage.

children.short_definition: 双臂高举过头，用力挥舞欢呼庆祝的欢呼动作。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求双臂高举欢呼或热烈庆祝时选择；动作幅度大；区别于普通加油。
children.proactive_expression: 重大成功或强烈庆祝场景选择；双臂高举并用力挥舞；轻度鼓励不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select for enthusiastic celebration with both arms raised and waved overhead; not for mild encouragement.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use for a major success, strong celebration, or enthusiastic cheering scene.

en-US.label: Raise both arms and cheer
en-US.short_definition: Raise both arms overhead and wave energetically in celebration.

en-US.label: Encouragement and celebration
en-US.short_definition: Use a main hand gesture such as clapping, fist pumping, arm waving, or high-fiving to encourage, cheer, or celebrate. If feet, head, facial expression, and hands form a complete sequential emotional performance, choose composite emotional actions. Distinguish from emphasis, invitations, and non-emotional arm lifts.

categories.short_definition: 以手掌向内招引或横向指示，表达请求靠近、邀请、召唤或跟随时选择；涵盖单/双手招手靠近和邀请；区别于问候告别、单一目标指向及礼仪手势。

children.short_definition: 单手掌心向上，手指连续向自身方向勾动。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求用一只手招呼靠近或过来时选择；掌心向上，手指朝自身勾动；区别于挥手问候。
children.proactive_expression: 邀请用户或目标靠近时选择；以单手反复向自身招引；问候或告别不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select for a one-hand gesture inviting someone to come closer; curl the fingers inward; not for waving hello.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when inviting the user or another target to approach with one hand; not for greeting or farewell.

en-US.label: Beckon with one hand
en-US.short_definition: Hold one palm upward and repeatedly curl the fingers toward oneself.

children.short_definition: 双掌向上，双手同时向自身反复勾动。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求用双手招呼靠近或热情召唤时选择；双掌向上并朝自身勾动；区别于双手挥别。
children.proactive_expression: 需要更强烈地邀请、热烈的招呼或召唤靠近时选择；双手同步向自身招引。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select for a two-hand gesture strongly inviting someone to come closer; not for waving goodbye.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when a stronger or more enthusiastic two-hand invitation to approach is needed.

en-US.label: Beckon with both hands
en-US.short_definition: Hold both palms upward and repeatedly beckon toward oneself with both hands together.

en-US.label: Beckoning and invitations
en-US.short_definition: Use inward beckoning palms or lateral indications to request approach, invite, summon, or ask someone to follow. Includes one/two-hand beckoning. Distinguish from greeting/farewell, pointing at a single target, and ceremonial gestures.

categories.short_definition: 以合十、抱拳、敬礼等规范手型和停留表达致谢、问候、致意或道歉时选择；鞠躬合手仍归本类，只有单次点头或不带规范手型的躯干鞠躬选择鞠躬与礼仪；区别于挥手问候、身体触碰和情绪化复合表演。

children.short_definition: 单手四指并拢，抬至眉梢停留的动作。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求敬礼或标准致敬动作时选择；并拢手指抬至眉梢；区别于普通挥手。
children.proactive_expression: 正式致意、致敬或纪律性场景选择；以标准单手敬礼表达。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select for a formal salute with the fingers together at the brow; not for an ordinary greeting wave.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use for formal acknowledgment, respect, or disciplined ceremonial situations.

en-US.label: Salute
en-US.short_definition: Hold four fingers of one hand together, raise them to the brow, and pause.

en-US.label: Ceremonial gestures and thanks
en-US.short_definition: Use conventional held hand poses such as joined palms, clasped-fist greetings, or salutes for thanks, greetings, acknowledgment, or apology. Bowing with joined hands stays here; a single nod or torso bow without a conventional hand pose belongs to bows and nods of greeting. Distinguish from waving, body touch, and composite emotional performances.

categories.short_definition: 手部直接接触自身皮肤、头发或身体部位，或请求明确命中舔舌头、嘘、勾引手势、侧耳倾听等本类固定局部动作时选择；涵盖摸、擦、挠、托、捂、撩发及拍胸。衣物或配饰是直接目标时选择穿戴与佩戴；由面部、手势、躯干等多个部位按顺序组成完整情绪表演时选择情绪动作。

children.short_definition: 单手指尖轻触鼻尖缓慢摩挲。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求触摸或摩挲鼻子时选择；指尖接触鼻尖；区别于捂嘴、摸脸或擦脸。
children.proactive_expression: 场景明确需要触碰鼻子时选择；思考停顿、轻微尴尬、闲聊下意识微动作；以单手指尖轻触并摩挲鼻尖。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when asked to touch or rub the nose with the fingertips; not for covering the mouth or touching the whole face.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use only when the scene explicitly requires touching or rubbing the nose.

en-US.label: Touch the nose
en-US.short_definition: Lightly touch and slowly rub the tip of the nose with one hand's fingertips.

children.short_definition: 单手指尖轻捏，摩挲耳廓与耳垂。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求摸、捏或摩挲耳朵时选择；手指接触耳廓或耳垂；区别于摸耳后、耳饰和侧耳倾听。
children.proactive_expression: 场景明确需要触碰耳廓或耳垂时选择；摸耳后、指耳示意或倾听时不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when asked to touch, pinch, or rub the outer ear or earlobe; not behind the ear, jewelry, or listening gestures.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use only when the scene explicitly requires contact with the outer ear or earlobe.

en-US.label: Touch the ear
en-US.short_definition: Gently pinch and rub the outer ear and earlobe with one hand's fingertips.

children.short_definition: 单侧手臂抬起，使用手指在耳廓后方及周边区域进行反复摩擦或抓挠。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求触摸、摩擦或抓挠耳朵后方时选择；区别于摸耳廓或耳垂。
children.proactive_expression: 场景明确需要整理或触碰耳后区域，或出现内心思索、权衡、推演、深度琢磨时选择；仅接触耳廓时不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when asked to touch, rub, or scratch behind the ear; not for touching the outer ear or earlobe.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when the scene explicitly requires adjusting or touching the area behind the ear.

en-US.label: Rub behind the ear
en-US.short_definition: Raise one arm and repeatedly rub or scratch behind and around the outer ear with the fingers.

children.short_definition: 单手手掌完整覆于前额，轻轻按压摩挲。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求手掌触摸额头、按压或摩挲额头时选择；区别于扶头表示头疼。
children.proactive_expression: 表示疲惫状态、口播停顿下意识触碰前额时，选择检查额头或明确需要触碰前额时选择；表现头疼时不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when asked to place a palm on, press, or rub the forehead; not for holding the head to show pain.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when checking or explicitly touching the forehead; not for expressing a headache.

en-US.label: Touch the forehead
en-US.short_definition: Cover the forehead with one palm and gently press and rub.

children.short_definition: 单手手掌贴合脸颊，面部，手指自然舒展触摸面部。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求用一只手触摸脸颊或面部时选择；手掌贴合面部；区别于捂脸或托腮。
children.proactive_expression: 场景适合思考停顿、略带羞涩、下意识轻摸脸颊的闲聊间隙；明确需要单手轻触面部时选择；无奈捂脸或托腮时不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when one hand should touch the cheek or face; not for covering the face or supporting the cheek.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when the scene explicitly requires a gentle one-hand touch to the face.

en-US.label: Touch the face with one hand
en-US.short_definition: Rest one palm against the cheek or face with fingers naturally spread to touch the face.

children.short_definition: 双手手掌贴合脸颊，面部，手指自然舒展触摸面部。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求双手同时触摸两侧脸颊时选择；双掌贴合面部；区别于双手托腮。
children.proactive_expression: 场景明确需要双手贴合面部时选择、女生长时间论述思考停顿、害羞、聆听、和观众日常唠嗑，听到有意思的分享，害羞或者沉思片刻时选择；承托脸颊或捂脸表演不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when both hands should touch both cheeks; not for supporting the cheeks or performing a face-covering reaction.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when the scene explicitly requires both palms against the face.

en-US.label: Touch the face with both hands
en-US.short_definition: Rest both palms against the cheeks or face with fingers naturally spread.

children.short_definition: 单根指尖轻点戳向自己脸颊，力度轻柔的可爱小动作。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求用一根手指轻戳脸颊时选择；力度轻柔；区别于摸脸或托腮。
children.proactive_expression: 卖萌、思考、闲聊或暧昧互动场景选择；以单指轻点脸颊。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when one fingertip should gently poke the cheek; not for touching the whole face or supporting the cheek.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when a playful or cute interaction explicitly calls for a cheek poke.

en-US.label: Poke one's cheek
en-US.short_definition: Gently tap or poke one's own cheek with one fingertip in a cute small motion.

children.short_definition: 单手交叉垫于后脑下方，手肘向外舒展的放松姿态。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求把一只手放在后脑勺时选择；手臂屈起置于脑后；区别于摸头或整理头发。
children.proactive_expression: 放松、尴尬或休息姿态需要手垫后脑时选择；整理头发时不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when one hand should rest behind the head; not for patting the head or adjusting hair.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use for a relaxed, awkward, or resting pose with one hand behind the head.

en-US.label: Rest one hand behind the head
en-US.short_definition: Place one hand behind the lower back of the head with the elbow extended outward in a relaxed pose.

children.short_definition: 单手抬手轻捋头顶，鬓角发丝，细微修整头发形态。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求摸头发、撩头发、整理发型、整理、轻捋或修整头发时选择；手指接触头顶或鬓角发丝；区别于摸头或摸耳后。
children.proactive_expression: 女性讲解轻松话题，适配松弛聊天氛围，自然仪容小动作；仪容整理场景需要调整头发时选择；以单手轻捋发丝。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when asked to fix, smooth, or arrange the hair; not for patting the head or touching behind the ear.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when a grooming scene explicitly requires adjusting the hair.

en-US.label: Adjust the hair
en-US.short_definition: Raise one hand and lightly smooth hair on top of the head or at the temples to make small styling adjustments.

children.short_definition: 单手抬手搭在肩头肩带或包带处，手指轻触拉起调整位置的小动作。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求触摸肩带或调整肩带时选择；手指接触带状物；区别于摸肩膀。
children.proactive_expression: 穿戴或包带场景需要调整肩带时选择，女生的习惯性聆听动作，女生闲聊时的伴随小动作；没有相关物体时不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when asked to touch or adjust a shoulder strap or bag strap; not for touching the shoulder itself.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when clothing or bag interaction explicitly requires adjusting a shoulder strap; a relevant strap must exist.

en-US.label: Touch a shoulder strap
en-US.short_definition: Rest one hand on a shoulder or bag strap and lightly lift or adjust it with the fingers.

children.short_definition: 单手握拳伸食指，指尖指向另一手摊开的掌心，双手抬于身前。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求一只手指向另一只手掌时选择；双手抬于身前；区别于普通摊掌展示。
children.proactive_expression: 讲解步骤、顺序、选择、汇总概括选择；以一手食指指向另一手掌心。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when one finger should point at the open palm of the other hand; not for a generic palm-up presentation.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when explaining a palm location or indicating something on the open hand.

en-US.label: Point a finger at the other palm
en-US.short_definition: Close one hand except for the extended index finger, point it at the other open palm, and hold both hands in front of the body.

children.short_definition: 轻咬大拇指指尖凝神思考。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求轻咬手指或做咬指思考动作时选择；区别于抚下巴或指太阳穴思考。
children.proactive_expression: 回复需要紧张、迟疑式思考时选择；以轻咬手指表现。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select for a light finger-biting action or specifically requested nervous thinking gesture; not for chin or temple thinking gestures.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when the reply calls for a hesitant, nervous, or contemplative finger-biting gesture.

en-US.label: Bite a finger thoughtfully
en-US.short_definition: Lightly bite the tip of the thumb while concentrating in thought.

children.short_definition: 单手食指指尖点向耳侧的示意动作。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求指向耳朵示意听、手指向耳朵时选择；食指点向耳侧；区别于手掌贴耳倾听。
children.proactive_expression: 提醒用户倾听或强调听觉时选择；以食指指耳示意。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when asked to point toward the ear as a listening cue; not for cupping the ear.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when prompting the user to listen or emphasizing hearing by pointing to the ear.

en-US.label: Point to the ear to invite listening
en-US.short_definition: Point one index fingertip toward the side of the ear.

children.short_definition: 单臂肘部弯曲抬起，手掌平直贴合单侧耳廓，头部同步向同侧偏斜。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求手掌贴耳、歪头认真听时选择；区别于仅指向耳朵。
children.proactive_expression: 回复需要表现正在仔细倾听时选择；以手掌贴耳并向同侧偏头。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when asked to cup the ear and tilt the head to listen carefully; not for merely pointing at the ear.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when the reply needs to show active, careful listening.

en-US.label: Cup an ear and listen
en-US.short_definition: Raise one bent arm, place the open hand against one outer ear, and tilt the head toward the same side.

children.short_definition: 单侧手臂弯曲抬起，掌心贴住脸颊承托。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求单手托住一侧脸颊时选择；掌心承托脸部；区别于普通摸脸。
children.proactive_expression: 休息、倾听、空闲或沉思时需要单手托脸选择；仅触摸面部时不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when one cheek should rest on one hand; not for simply touching the face.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use for a resting, listening, or thoughtful one-hand cheek-support pose.

en-US.label: Support one cheek with a hand
en-US.short_definition: Raise one bent arm and support the cheek with the palm.

children.short_definition: 双手屈肘抬起，掌心分托脸颊两侧。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求双手托住两侧脸颊、两只手托脸时选择；双掌承托脸部；区别于双手摸脸。
children.proactive_expression: 卖萌、等待或沉思时需要双手托腮选择；仅触摸面部时不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when both cheeks should rest on both hands; not for simply touching both cheeks.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use for a cute, waiting, or thoughtful two-hand cheek-support pose.

en-US.label: Support both cheeks with the hands
en-US.short_definition: Raise both bent arms and support each cheek with a palm.

children.short_definition: 单手掌心轻拍，落于自身胸口位置。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求拍胸口表示放心、拍胸口、你保证或松一口气时选择；单手轻拍胸口。
children.proactive_expression: 安抚、保证或表达放心、诚恳表达自己的态度时选择；以单手轻拍胸口；静态抚胸不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when asked to pat the chest to express reassurance, confidence, or relief.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when reassuring, making a promise, or expressing relief with a light one-hand chest pat; not for a static chest touch.

en-US.label: Pat the chest reassuringly
en-US.short_definition: Gently pat one's own chest with one palm.

children.short_definition: 双臂弯曲向上抬起同时将双手手掌按压自身胸部位置或放置在自。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求双手按住胸口、两只手捂胸、双手放胸前时选择；两只手同时贴于胸前；区别于单手抚胸或拍胸。
children.proactive_expression: 感动、惊讶或强烈情绪需要双手捂胸时选择；单手表达不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when both hands should be placed over the chest; not for a one-hand chest touch or chest pat.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when strong emotion, surprise, or being deeply moved calls for both hands over the chest.

en-US.label: Cover the chest with both hands
en-US.short_definition: Bend and raise both arms and press both palms against one's own chest.

en-US.label: Body touch
en-US.short_definition: Use direct hand contact with one's skin, hair, or body, or explicit requests for fixed local actions in this category such as tongue licking, shushing, a seductive gesture, or cupping an ear to listen. Includes touching, rubbing, scratching, supporting, covering, hair brushing, and chest patting. Clothing/accessories as the direct target belong to clothing and accessories. Complete sequential performances coordinating face, gestures, and torso belong to composite emotional actions.

categories.short_definition: 手指、指尖或手掌在不接触身体、实体物品或真实乐器时完成局部收拢、展开、捏合、滑动、弹击、交握、敲击或模拟弹奏时选择；约定数字或图形手型选择符号化手势，强化话语选择强调类，明确操作真实乐器选择舞台表现。

children.short_definition: 单手五指由张开状态收拢并齐。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求一只手的五指收拢并齐时选择；手指由张开变为并拢；区别于握拳。
children.proactive_expression: 演示单手手指由张开变为并拢时选择；五指不向掌心握紧。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when all five fingers of one hand should close together from a spread position; not for making a fist.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when demonstrating fingers changing from spread to aligned and closed together.

en-US.label: Bring one hand's fingers together
en-US.short_definition: Bring all five spread fingers of one hand together.

children.short_definition: 双手五指由并拢状态展开分散。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求双手五指展开时选择；两手手指由并拢变为张开；区别于摊掌展示或数字手势。
children.proactive_expression: 表示总结阐释、严肃、诚恳语气、演示双手手指展开时选择；不承担展示或数字含义。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when both hands should spread all fingers; not for a palm presentation or number gesture.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when demonstrating both hands opening their fingers without presentation or number meaning.

en-US.label: Spread the fingers of both hands
en-US.short_definition: Spread all five fingers of each hand from a closed-together position.

children.short_definition: 单手食指或中指指尖发力，轻点物体或空中示意。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求用指尖轻点物体或空中位置时选择；动作轻短；区别于按下实体按钮。
children.proactive_expression: 讲解陈述内容时的伴随动作，出现质疑、追问、演示轻点、点选或提示某处时选择，常用于博客、资讯博主、正式内容讲解；需要下压实体按钮时不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when a fingertip should tap lightly on an object or in the air; not for pressing a physical button.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when demonstrating tapping, selecting, or lightly indicating a position; not for a firm button press.

en-US.label: Tap with a finger
en-US.short_definition: Lightly tap an object or gesture in the air with one index or middle fingertip.

children.short_definition: 单手的拇指与食指相对，捏合成钳状。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求捏合手势、两指捏合、拇指和食指捏合时选择；两指形成钳状；区别于比心或数字手势。
children.proactive_expression: 表示重点关键词、出现总结性、类比性陈述或表示细小、夹取或捏合操作时选择；以拇指和食指相对捏合。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when the thumb and index finger should pinch together; not for a heart or number gesture.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when representing something small, picking up a small item, or demonstrating pinching.

en-US.label: Pinch with two fingers
en-US.short_definition: Bring one thumb and index finger together in a pincer shape.

children.short_definition: 单手的手指贴合表面，缓慢滑行移动。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求手指沿表面滑动时选择；指尖持续移动；区别于轻点或按实体按钮。
children.proactive_expression: 陈述内容时的习惯性手部动作、演示滑动、拖动或滑屏操作、介绍长图表、事件时间线，配合手指滑动示意内容延展、讲解商品详情、讲解长文档、流程图，用滑动动作示意阅读顺序、内容延展时选择；单次点击不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when a finger should slide continuously along a surface; not for tapping or pressing a physical button.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when demonstrating sliding, dragging, or swiping; not for a single tap.

en-US.label: Slide the fingers
en-US.short_definition: Keep one hand's fingers against a surface and slide them slowly.

children.short_definition: 单侧手五指向内收紧，攥成紧实拳头的静态手势。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求左手握拳、右手握拳、一只手握拳、单手握成静态拳头时选择；五指收紧成拳；区别于加油、强调或挥拳。
children.proactive_expression: 陈述内容时表示强调、表达亢奋情绪、演示握拳手型且无鼓励或强调语义时选择；拳头保持静态。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select for a static one-hand fist; not for cheering, emphasis, or punching.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when demonstrating a fist shape without encouragement or emphasis; keep the fist static.

en-US.label: Make one fist
en-US.short_definition: Tightly curl all five fingers of one hand inward into a static fist.

children.short_definition: 双臂抬起置于身前左右两侧，双手掌心明确朝向正前方。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求做空气引号、双引号或引用手势时选择；双手在身前配合示意引用。
children.proactive_expression: 引用特殊词语或表达反讽时选择；以双手做引号手势。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when asked for air quotes, quotation marks, or a quoting gesture using both hands.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when quoting a marked phrase or expressing verbal irony with air quotes.

en-US.label: Air-quote gesture
en-US.short_definition: Raise both arms to either side in front of the body, with both palms clearly facing forward.

children.short_definition: 单侧手臂向前甩出，以手腕为轴心。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求甩手腕、转花手或做花手动作时选择；动作核心是腕部旋转。
children.proactive_expression: 舞蹈、展示或活泼表达需要花手时选择；以单手腕部旋转表现。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when asked for a wrist flourish or rotating flower-hand gesture; the wrist is the main motion.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when dance, presentation, or playful expression calls for a one-hand wrist flourish.

en-US.label: Wrist flourish
en-US.short_definition: Throw one arm forward with the wrist as the pivot.

children.short_definition: 单手的食指伸出左右摇摆表示不可的否定动作。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求摇动食指表示不行、左右摇晃食指、不要或否定时选择；食指左右摆动。
children.proactive_expression: 回复明确表达轻度拒绝或否定、陈述负面信息时选择；以食指左右摇摆强化含义。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when asked to wag the index finger to mean no, do not, or not allowed.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when the reply expresses a light refusal, prohibition, or negative response with a wagging index finger.

en-US.label: Wag an index finger to say no
en-US.short_definition: Extend one index finger and wag it side to side in denial.

en-US.label: Fine finger movements
en-US.short_definition: Use local finger/hand closing, spreading, pinching, sliding, flicking, clasping, tapping, or simulated playing without contact with the body, a physical object, or a real instrument. Conventional numeric/shape signs belong to symbolic gestures; speech reinforcement belongs to emphasis; actual instrument operation belongs to stage performance.

categories.short_definition: 头部、手臂、躯干至少两处协同，并让视线与手部共同朝向目标以欢迎或介绍时选择；涵盖左右/向前引导和介绍空间位置；区别于单一指向、单部位动作及舞台编排。

children.short_definition: 头部转向左侧，单侧手臂同步抬起指引的引导动作。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求头部和手臂共同引导看向角色左侧时选择；区别于单一指向。
children.proactive_expression: 介绍角色左侧的目标、外部、入口、另一侧或区域时选择；头部转左并以手臂引导。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when the head and arm should jointly guide attention toward the character's left; not for simple pointing.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when introducing a target, entrance, or area on the character's left.

en-US.label: Guide attention to the left
en-US.short_definition: Turn the head left and simultaneously raise one arm to guide attention.

en-US.label: Welcome and guidance
en-US.short_definition: Use at least two coordinated regions among head, arms, and torso, with gaze and hand directed toward the same target to welcome or introduce. Includes guiding left/right/forward and introducing spatial locations. Distinguish from isolated pointing, single-region actions, and stage choreography.

categories.short_definition: 面部、头部、手势、躯干或下肢中至少两处协同，或多个动作按顺序组成完整情绪、亲昵、思考或反应表演时选择；涵盖卖萌、撒娇、抱头惊讶、摊手无奈、复合庆祝鼓励、抚下巴思考、亲吻和复合勾引表演。只有单一面部变化、单一鼓励手势或目录已明确收录的局部身体动作时，选择对应基础类别。

children.source_label: 自信表达（双手叉腰，挺胸抬头，下巴微微扬起，目视前方）
children.short_definition: 双手叉腰，挺胸抬头并将下巴微微扬起。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求呈现自信状态、自信动作、双手叉腰挺胸抬头表达自信时选择；区别于单手叉腰。
children.proactive_expression: 回复需要完整、明显的自信姿态时选择；双手叉腰并挺胸抬头。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select for a confident pose with both hands on the hips, chest lifted, and head raised; not for one hand on the hip.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when the reply needs a complete and clearly confident full-body pose.

en-US.label: Confident pose: hands on hips, chest out, chin up
en-US.short_definition: Place both hands on the hips, lift the chest and head, and slightly raise the chin.

children.source_label: 娇羞（低头双手捂脸，身体左右轻晃）
children.short_definition: 低头双手捂脸，身体左右轻轻晃动。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求娇羞动作或低头双手捂脸表达以及夸赞主播时选择；区别于单一害羞表情。
children.proactive_expression: 回复需要完整的害羞或娇羞表演、讲述令人脸红的话题时选择；低头捂脸并左右轻晃。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select for a shy performance with the head lowered, both hands covering the face, and the body gently swaying.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when the reply requires a complete shy or bashful performance.

en-US.label: Shy pose: head down, face covered, gentle swaying
en-US.short_definition: Lower the head, cover the face with both hands, and gently sway side to side.

children.source_label: 打哈欠（单手捂嘴身体后仰）
children.short_definition: 单手捂嘴，身体随张口向后微仰。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求捂嘴、后仰并做打哈欠动作时选择；区别于咳嗽或捂嘴笑。
children.proactive_expression: 疲倦或困倦场景、长篇讲解知识点后的停顿间隙演示困倦生理反应，明确需要打哈欠时选择；单手捂嘴并微微后仰。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select for a yawn with one hand covering the mouth and the body leaning slightly backward; not for coughing or laughing.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when tiredness or sleepiness explicitly calls for a yawning action.

en-US.label: Yawn with one hand over the mouth and lean back
en-US.short_definition: Cover the mouth with one hand and lean the body slightly backward as the mouth opens.

children.short_definition: 手扶头部，眉头紧皱的疼痛表情。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求手扶头并表现头疼时选择；带有疼痛神态；区别于普通摸额头。
children.proactive_expression: 回复或表演明确表达头痛不适、共情痛苦、表达无能为力、没有办法、事情不受控制时选择时选择；以手扶头配合痛苦表情。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when asked to hold the head and show headache discomfort; not for simply touching the forehead.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when the reply or performance explicitly expresses a headache.

en-US.label: Headache gesture
en-US.short_definition: Hold the head with a hand and tightly knit the brows in pain.

children.short_definition: 单手掌心覆面，头部微低的无奈动作。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求单手捂脸表达无奈、捂脸无奈、尴尬或无语时选择；区别于普通摸脸。
children.proactive_expression: 回复需要明显的无奈或尴尬反应时、遇到槽点、哭笑不得、小翻车、无语、尴尬、轻微吐槽，需要流露无奈情绪时选择；单手覆面并微微低头。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select for a one-hand facepalm expressing helplessness, embarrassment, or disbelief; not for simply touching the face.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when the reply calls for a clear helpless or embarrassed reaction.

en-US.label: One-hand facepalm of helplessness
en-US.short_definition: Cover the face with one palm and slightly lower the head in helplessness.

children.short_definition: 单手捂住嘴巴，抑制笑意的表情动作。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求捂嘴笑、偷笑或抑制笑意时选择；区别于咳嗽或普通微笑。
children.proactive_expression: 回复需要玩笑、玩梗、闲谈打趣、含蓄调侃、略带害羞/不好意思的自嘲、轻微八卦、憋笑场景时选用；单手捂住嘴部。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when asked to cover the mouth while laughing, giggling, or suppressing a smile; not for coughing or yawning.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when the reply calls for a restrained, shy, or discreet laugh.

en-US.label: Cover the mouth while laughing
en-US.short_definition: Cover the mouth with one hand while suppressing laughter.

children.source_label: 单指轻抚下巴表示思考
children.short_definition: 视线移开，单指沿下巴轻轻抚过。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求用手指轻抚下巴表现思考时选择；区别于指太阳穴或咬手指。
children.proactive_expression: 回复需要犹豫、分析、长时间停顿表示沉思时选择；以单指轻抚下巴表现。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when asked to lightly stroke the chin with one finger to show thinking; not for temple or finger-biting gestures.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when the reply calls for hesitation, analysis, or contemplation with a chin stroke.

en-US.label: Stroke the chin with one finger in thought
en-US.short_definition: Look away and gently stroke along the chin with one finger.

children.source_label: 单手指太阳穴表示思考
children.short_definition: 单手指尖轻抵太阳穴，配合思考神态。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求手指抵住太阳穴表现思考时选择；区别于抚下巴或扶头疼痛。
children.proactive_expression: 回复需要集中思考、沉思或回忆时选择；以单手指尖轻抵太阳穴。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when asked to place a fingertip against the temple to show thinking; not for chin stroking or headache pain.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when the reply calls for concentrated thinking or recalling information.

en-US.label: Touch the temple in thought
en-US.short_definition: Lightly rest one hand's fingertips against the temple with a thoughtful expression.

children.short_definition: 单手手背朝上握拳同时向上抬起轻置于嘴巴处或鼻子下方。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求握拳靠近嘴部做咳嗽动作时选择；区别于捂嘴笑或打哈欠。
children.proactive_expression: 表演咳嗽或需要咳嗽式停顿时选择，回复需要强调观点、严肃政治话题与轻松谈话间的间隙过度动作，适用于中老年、主播谈话间隙动作；以拳头靠近嘴部。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select for a cough gesture with a fist raised near the mouth; not for covered-mouth laughter or yawning.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when the performance calls for coughing or a cough-like pause.

en-US.label: Cough gesture
en-US.short_definition: Make a fist with the back of the hand upward and raise it gently to the mouth or just below the nose.

children.short_definition: 头部向左侧肩膀明显倾斜，头部贴近左侧肩膀处。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求向角色左侧歪头并耸肩时选择；区别于仅转头或仅侧倾。
children.proactive_expression: 回复需要左倾的疑惑、轻松、分析、闲聊过渡、观点输出或无奈姿态时选择；头部贴近左肩并耸肩。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when asked to tilt the head toward the character's left shoulder and shrug; not for merely turning the head.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when the reply calls for a left-leaning puzzled, casual, or helpless pose.

en-US.label: Tilt the head left and shrug
en-US.short_definition: Tilt the head clearly toward the left shoulder, bringing it close to that shoulder.

en-US.label: Composite emotional actions
en-US.short_definition: Use at least two coordinated regions among face, head, hands, torso, or legs, or a sequence forming a complete emotional, affectionate, thinking, or reaction performance. Includes acting cute, coy affection, surprise with hands on head, helpless open palms, composite cheering, chin-stroking thought, kissing, and composite seductive performances. A single facial change, encouragement gesture, or catalogued local body action belongs to its corresponding basic category.

categories.short_definition: 借助现实工具或日用品完成其明确功能时选择；涵盖书写、实体书翻开翻页、喝口水或喝点水、通话、麦克风讲话、手持手机、遥控器或键盘操作、开伞、戴上耳机、闻、涂抹、看表、挤压、进食和摸宠物；未指定容器的喝水默认使用杯子。戴上耳机归本类，调整已经佩戴的耳机归穿戴与佩戴；翻书、开伞和设备控制键按功能归本类，纯盒盖、瓶盖、抽屉、拉链或包装开合归物品开合。

children.short_definition: 单手握手机机身，低头注视屏幕。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求拿手机查看、读取或看手机屏幕时选择；必须明确涉及手机。
children.proactive_expression: 回复明确需要借助手机查看信息时选择；单手持手机并低头看屏幕。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when asked to hold a phone and check, read, or look at its screen; a phone must be explicitly involved.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when the reply explicitly requires checking information on a phone.

en-US.label: Look at a phone
en-US.short_definition: Hold a phone in one hand and lower the head to look at the screen.

en-US.label: Tools and everyday objects
en-US.short_definition: Use real tools or everyday objects for their specific function: writing, opening/turning book pages, drinking water, phone calls, speaking into a microphone, holding a phone, operating a remote/keyboard, opening an umbrella, putting on headphones, smelling, applying substances, checking a watch, squeezing, eating, or petting an animal. Drinking water defaults to a cup when no container is specified. Putting on headphones belongs here; adjusting worn headphones belongs to clothing/accessories. Books, umbrellas, and device controls belong here by function; plain lids, caps, drawers, zippers, or packaging belong to object opening/state operations.

categories.short_definition: 以衣物、配饰、防护用品或背包等穿戴物为直接对象，改变、整理或展示其位置、形态或穿戴关系时选择，即使表现为触碰、抓取、拉扯或拨动也优先归本类；涵盖帽子、眼镜、口罩、背包、衣领袖口、领带围巾、已佩戴耳机、口袋、项链戒指及露肌肉造型。戴上耳机选择工具与日用品使用，调整已戴耳机选择本类；手插兜归本类，物品放入口袋归隐藏与收纳，物品从口袋取出归拿取与取出；穿着中的扣子和拉链归本类。现有“手拿鲜花叼嘴上/刁嘴上”作为本类固定造型处理。

children.short_definition: 单侧手臂弯曲抬起至胸前，手掌自然张开或微曲。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求单手放在胸前或轻抚胸口时选择；区别于拍胸或双手捂胸。
children.proactive_expression: 表达真诚、感动或平静时需要单手抚胸选择；拍击或双手动作不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when asked to place or gently stroke one hand over the chest; not for chest patting or both hands over the chest.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when expressing sincerity, calm emotion, or being moved with one hand on the chest.

en-US.label: Rest one hand on the chest
en-US.short_definition: Bend and raise one arm in front of the chest with the palm naturally open or slightly curved.

en-US.label: Clothing and accessories
en-US.short_definition: Use when clothing, accessories, protective wear, or backpacks are the direct target and the action changes, adjusts, or displays their position, shape, or worn relationship, even through touching, grasping, pulling, or flicking. Includes hats, glasses, masks, backpacks, collars/cuffs, ties/scarves, worn headphones, pockets, necklaces/rings, and muscle-revealing poses. Putting on headphones belongs to tools; adjusting worn headphones belongs here. Hands in pockets belong here; putting objects in pockets belongs to storage, and taking objects out belongs to retrieval. Buttons/zippers on worn clothes belong here. The existing holding-flowers-in-the-mouth pose is treated as a fixed pose in this category.

categories.short_definition: 完整动作只为改变实体物体的开合或结构状态，结果是打开、关闭、拧紧、拉合、撕开或折断时选择；涵盖盒盖、瓶盖、独立实体按钮、抽屉、非穿着物拉链、包装和掰拧物体。翻开书、开伞和设备控制键选择工具与日用品使用；穿着中衣物扣子或拉链选择穿戴与佩戴；打开包装后继续展示选择展示与讲解。

children.short_definition: 单手食指伸出，垂直下压按钮。
children.user_reaction_expression: 用户要求用食指按下实体按钮时选择；动作包含明确下压；区别于点屏幕或空中轻点。
children.proactive_expression: 操作明确存在的实体按钮时选择；以食指垂直下压；触屏操作不得选择。

en-US.user_reaction_expression: Select when asked to press a physical button downward with the index finger; not for tapping a screen or pointing in the air.
en-US.proactive_expression: Use when operating a clearly present physical button with a vertical index-finger press.

en-US.label: Press a physical button
en-US.short_definition: Extend one index finger and press a button vertically downward.

en-US.label: Object opening and state operations
en-US.short_definition: Use when the entire action changes a physical object's opening or structural state: opening, closing, tightening, zipping, tearing, or breaking. Includes lids, caps, standalone physical buttons, drawers, zippers on unworn objects, packaging, and bending/twisting objects. Opening books/umbrellas and device controls belong to tools; buttons/zippers on worn clothes belong to clothing/accessories; opening packaging followed by display belongs to display and explanation.
